main.description: An artist profile published to an AT Protocol personal data server. Links a creator's DID to a public display name.

did.description: The AT Protocol DID of the account that owns this artist profile. The canonical persistent identifier for the creator's identity.

name.description: The public display name for this artist.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this record was created, in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format.
